sentiment.rationale: The document reports record quarterly revenue and strong adjusted net income growth, with all business groups and geographies growing double-digits, indicating genuine operational momentum. However, there is no explicit forward guidance raise; management expresses confidence in the Hybrid AI strategy and stabilizing macro environment but does not provide specific numeric guidance changes. The positive trajectory and confident language support a moderately positive score, but the absence of a formal guidance raise and the presence of non-cash adjustments (warrants, convertible bonds) temper the score.

summary.eps: Basic EPS 2.77 US cents, down 5% year-on-year; diluted EPS 2.52 US cents, down 9%.
summary.guidance: No explicit numeric guidance provided. Management states 'Positive signs of stabilization in external environment' and 'Driving strategy to capture Hybrid AI opportunities' but does not raise or lower formal guidance.
summary.margin: Gross margin 15.4% (down 0.3 pts YoY); operating margin 3.1% (down 0.5 pts YoY); adjusted net income margin 2.5% (up 0.2 pts YoY).
key_risks: Non-cash fair value loss on warrants (US$148M) and notional interest on convertible bonds (US$28M) impacting reported net income.
Operating profit declined 1% YoY due to increased operating expenses.
ISG still reported an operating loss (US$32M) despite revenue growth.
Forward-looking statements caution about risks including economic conditions, competition, and regulatory changes.
key_opportunities: AI-related revenue mix increased to 30% of total revenue, up 13 pts YoY.
AI Servers high-double-digit growth; AI PCs, AI smartphones, AI Services triple-digit growth.
AI PC penetration reached 33% of shipments; #1 in Windows AI PC with 31.1% share.
ISG revenue grew 24% YoY with strong pipeline; liquid cooling revenue up 154%.
SSG delivered 18th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth; operating margin over 22%.
Shift from AI training to inferencing expected to fuel growth in AI devices and applications.
Enterprise and SMB AI adoption expected to drive infrastructure growth.
